newsitem.title: JAPAN: Refinery operations unaffected by Tokyo earthquake.
newsitem.headline: Refinery operations unaffected by Tokyo earthquake.

text.p: Operations of refineries located on the outskirts of Tokyo have not been affected by a strong earthquake, which measured five on the Richter scale, that hit Tokyo and surrounding regions on Wednesday evening, refinery spokesmen said.
"The earthquake has not disrupted plant operations," said a spokesman for Cosmo Oil Co Ltd, which runs a 240,000 barrels-per-day plant in Chiba, east of Tokyo.

Other refiners with plants around Tokyo, including Nippon Oil Co Ltd, Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd and Tonen Corp said their refineries were continuing normal operations and were not affected by the earthquake.
